literal_meaning: with smoke and drum-like noise (onomatopoeic for fanfare)
figurative_meaning_en: pomp and grandeur, splendor and ceremony
example_sentences_in_bangla: ধুমধাম করে বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠান সম্পন্ন হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: The wedding was held with great pomp and ceremony.
They celebrated the festival in grand style.
note: Commonly used in contexts of lavish events in Bengali culture
